answer: Behind the cooper's yard the staves stand in rows, seasoning in the rain before they are ever bent. Proof of cooper barrel via stave hoop count is the binding: a barrel the cooper binds only after 14 staves are hooped, each stave fitted by the cooper himself. The ripple is the first stave, fitted when the wood was green; the vine is the fourteenth, fitted when the barrel held water. A cheat must fit 21 false staves and hoop 21 false barrels, and the meadow still holds no ale.
